long_description:
Passionate about helping children thrive in school and at home? Looking for ways to make a difference in the lives of children in your community while earning income? LOVE music? Learn how to teach yoga, mindfulness and meditation to kids in schools, at home and within community settings in one fun-filled weekend!

You don't have to be a yoga teacher to participate. This training is for parents, yoga teachers and all professionals who work with kids that want to continue their education.

Go straight to the training page to register: https://kiddingaroundyoga.com/events/orlando-fl-5/

Scroll down for specific location details.

We hope you'll join us for a weekend of life changing fun! 

Can't make this training? Don't worry! See if other locations or dates work better for you: https://kiddingaroundyoga.com/trainings/ 

Or, better yet, sign up to our email list to stay up to date on all things KAY.

 https://kiddingaroundyoga.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=a8106fde0f1fb07a6be2f4378&id=0461620b2f

Tickets can ONLY be purchased through Kidding Around Yoga. We monitor the comments on all our events closely and remove any comments which we believe to be Spam, however if you see someone advertising 'tickets' for this event, please do NOT click any links that are posted and instead alert us so we can remove any potentially harmful links.

LOCATION SPECIFIC INFORMATION:

Location Name: Elevate Yoga Center

Address: 3150 S Orange Ave Unit 204

Orlando, FL 32806

Parking: lots of ample parking. 

Hotels: Hampton Inn and Suites and Towneplace Suites by Marriott.

Join our free family class!
